The above writ petition has been filed for a Writ of Mandamus to direct the respondents to restore the land in R.S.No.241/4, formerly R.S.No.241/2, measuring an extent of 1.51.0 hectare (1 Acre and 77 Cents) situated in Lakshathope, part of Maharajasamudram Village, Pattukottai Taluk, in favour of the petitioners under the land acquisition proceedings in pursuance of G.O.Ms.No.1193, Housing and Urban Development Department, dated 08.11.1985 and under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2.It is informed by the learned counsel for the fourth respondent that the petitioners' lands have not been acquired, possession continues with the petitioners and no award has been passed.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that in the W.P.No.3257 of 1986 the petitioners has stated that without giving any notice the G.O.Ms. No. 1193, Housing and Urban Development Department, dated 08.11.1985 has been issued and she had came known only while publication in Dinathanthi paper dated 10.12.1985 purporting to be under Section 6 of the Land Land acquisition Act and Special Tahsildar of Lnd Acquisition proposed to demolish their four houses which was constructed after getting Building permission No. 196/85 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis dt.30.09.1985 from Pattukottai Municipality G.O Ms.No.1193, Housing and Urban Development Department, dated 08:11.1985 has been issued after

during enquiry Thiru. Gurumanickam, Advocate had appeared on behalf of all land ex-owner including Thiru. Thambaiah, husband of Writ petitioner Tmt.
Pavalakodi.
Thereby suppressing the above facts the petitioner got favorable orders in WP No 3257 of 1986 on 12.02.1996.
Then Writ Appeal No.1458 of 2001 has been filed against the above said order.
The above facts were submitted before the Hon'ble High Court in Writ Appeal.
Hence, order was passed in the above Appeal case in favour of Government.

7. It is submitted that in respect of Survey No.241/4 the acquisition proceedings was stopped by the 3rd respondent at the stage of Award Enquiry itself on 02.05.1986 based on the objection given by the petitioner citing pendency of the writ petition before this Hon'ble Court in W.P.No.3257/1986 at that point of time.

As such there was no adjudication made in so far as the subject Survey No. 241/4 and the Award No. 1/86 dt. 05.06.1986 was passed excluding the above Survey No.241/4."
3.In the light of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the fourth respondent, no further adjudication is required in this writ petition.
Therefore, the Writ Petition stands closed in the light of the above submissions.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
